notes:
New in 0.9.9:
- Patches and setup files: Library ⋮ › Run a file… runs a game's .bat, .exe, .msi, .reg or PowerShell file once in Windows, or any file you pick on the phone. The game folder (⋮ › Open game folder) has Run in Windows on these files too. EdRoid tells you afterwards whether it worked.
- Automatic setup: when you press Play, EdRoid offers to run a setup step the game needs first, such as an English patch's "Apply English patch.bat" that its readme says to run once.
- Setup files that need PowerShell work now: EdRoid downloads Microsoft PowerShell once (about 110 MB) the first time one needs it.
- Windows games keep running when you leave them (hold the gear › Keep running when I leave) and have their own card in Recents. Exit game goes back to the Library.
- One menu for everything: hold the gear or press Back. Make new on-screen buttons or copy them right from the game.
- Games with a choose-a-file window (DLC, mods): hold the gear › Choose a file from the phone… and EdRoid fills it in.
- File manager: copy or move files, add whole folders from the phone, and go to the Windows C: drive or Download.
- Games start faster, and the Library keeps your place.
